title: Healthy habits
subtitle: Maya's lesson on healthy living — too much, too many, (not) enough
canDo: I can talk about my habits: sleep, food, drinks and exercise.
I can use too much, too many and (not) enough.
I can understand a short article with health tips.
teacherNotes: too much (sayılamayan) / too many (sayılabilen) ayrımı bir önceki dersteki How much / How many ile aynı mantıkta. İkisini yan yana yazın.
enough isimden önce (enough water), fiilden sonra gelir (You don't sleep enough). Türk öğrenciler "water enough" diyebilir.
Sınıf anketi: How many hours do you sleep? How much water do you drink? How many cups of coffee? Sonuçları "too much / not enough" ile yorumlatın.
Konuyu yargılayıcı değil, esprili tutun: Maya da "Nobody's perfect!" diyor.

sections.heading: Nobody's perfect
sections.scene: Monday morning. Lucas is back at school.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Welcome back, Lucas! How are you feeling?

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: Much better, thanks. Omar's soup saved me.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Good. Today we're talking about healthy habits. Let's start with sleep. How many hours do you sleep, Lucas?

lines.speaker: lucas
lines.text: Um … five? I play the guitar until two in the morning.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Five? That's not enough sleep! You should sleep at least seven hours.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: And Elif, how much coffee do you drink?

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Three cups a day. Sometimes four.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: That's too much coffee, Elif. And you put three spoons of sugar in every cup!

lines.speaker: elif
lines.text: Two spoons! And you drink too much coffee too, Omar.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: That's true. But I walk to the hospital every day, and I always take the stairs. That's forty minutes of exercise.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Very good. And me? I eat too many snacks when I check your homework. Nobody's perfect!

sections.title: Read
sections.heading: Five small habits for a healthier life
sections.intro: Maya's page in the school newsletter.
paragraphs: You don't need to run a marathon. Small changes are often the best changes.
1. Drink more water. A lot of people don't drink enough water in winter because they aren't thirsty. Try to drink six to eight glasses a day.
2. Move every day. You should get at least thirty minutes of exercise a day, and walking is exercise too! Take the stairs, not the elevator, and get off the bus one stop early.
3. Sleep more. Adults need seven to nine hours of sleep, but too many people sleep only five or six.
4. Eat less sugar. There's too much sugar in a lot of drinks and snacks. One can of soda has about nine teaspoons of sugar! Eat fruit or nuts as a snack instead.
5. Turn off your screen. Too much screen time before bed is bad for your sleep. Put your phone away an hour before bed.
Start with one habit this week. Next week, add another one. Your body is going to thank you!

sections.title: Grammar: too much, too many, (not) enough
look: A lot of people **don't drink enough water**.
rules: **too many** + plural nouns: *too many cookies*. **too much** + uncountable nouns: *too much coffee*.
**enough** goes before a noun: *enough sleep* (not *sleep enough*). After a verb: *You don't sleep enough.*
**too much** can also come after a verb: *He works too much.*
examples: There's too much salt in this soup.

support.tr: too many = çok fazla (sayılabilen, çoğul isimlerle: too many snacks), too much = çok fazla (sayılamayan isimlerle: too much sugar). not enough = yeterli değil: not enough sleep. enough isimden önce gelir (enough water), fiilden sonra gelir (You don't sleep enough). Hatırla: too = bir sorun var.
support.ar: too many = كثير جدًّا (مع المعدود الجمع: too many snacks)، too much = كثير جدًّا (مع غير المعدود: too much sugar). not enough = غير كافٍ: not enough sleep. تأتي enough قبل الاسم (enough water) وبعد الفعل (You don't sleep enough). تذكّر: too = توجد مشكلة.

tr.note: much / many karıştırılmaz; enough isimden önce gelir.

ar.note: sugar و coffee غير معدودة: too much.
wrong: There are too many sugar in this tea.
right: There's too much sugar in this tea.

sections.title: Practice
sections.instructions: Complete with too much, too many or enough.
items: I drink five cups of coffee a day. That's {too much} coffee.
Lucas eats {too many} cookies. Ten a day!
I sleep only five hours. I don't sleep {enough}.
There's {too much} sugar in this drink. Nine teaspoons!

We have only ten minutes. That isn't {enough} time for lunch.

sections.title: Write: My habits

model.heading: The good and the bad — Omar
text: My good habits: I walk to the hospital every day, and I always take the stairs.
I eat a lot of vegetables, and I never drink soda.
My bad habits: I drink too much coffee, especially at work.
On Monday nights, I don't get enough sleep. And I eat too many dates!
My plan: from next week, only two coffees a day.
And I'm going to go to bed earlier on Sundays.
